news.headline: Ravens' Zay Flowers doubtful vs. Saints; Nnamdi Madubuike out
news.description: Ravens receiver Zay Flowers is doubtful for Sunday's game vs. the Saints after he aggravated a left hamstring injury and missed the majority of practices this week.

news.headline: Vikings to start QB Wentz vs. Bears with Murray still on the mend
news.description: Carson Wentz will be the Vikings' starting quarterback Sunday against the Bears while Kyler Murray continues to work his way back after suffering a concussion in the season opener.

news.headline: Texans rule WR Nico Collins out vs. Bengals with hamstring injury
news.description: The Texans have ruled star wide receiver Nico Collins out for Sunday's matchup against the Bengals due to a hamstring injury.

news.headline: Raiders listing TE Brock Bowers as doubtful vs. Chargers
news.description: Brock Bowers is doubtful to play against the Chargers, though the Raiders will see how the tight end feels pregame before making a final decision.

news.headline: Bills to take time with Ed Oliver, DJ Moore injuries
news.description: A long week will give more time for Bills defensive lineman Ed Oliver (hip) and wide receiver DJ Moore (shoulder) to get healthy following Thursday's injuries.

news.headline: Commanders rule out Frankie Luvu, Chig Okonkwo vs. Cowboys
news.description: The Commanders have ruled out linebacker Frankie Luvu, and tight end Chig Okonkwo for Sunday's road game against Dallas, coach Dan Quinn said.

news.headline: Dolphins not discouraged by Chris Johnson's rough stat sheet
news.description: Coach Jeff Hafley found positives for first-round cornerback Chris Johnson despite a hard day at the office.

news.headline: Eagles' new perspective for '26: Don't 'let anyone steal our joy'
news.description: It's no coincidence the mood inside Philly's locker room was at its most sullen in 2023 and '25, two seasons following Super Bowl runs.

news.headline: Cam Skattebo reclaims role as Giants' feature back
news.description: Just like that, it's business as usual for the bruising running back as he dominated the field in Week 1 against the Cowboys.

news.headline: Rams' Donald plans to play vs. Giants; Nacua (hip) misses practice
news.description: Rams DT Aaron Donald said Friday "the plan" is to play Monday night against the Giants, while WR Puka Nacua did not practice on Friday with a hip issue.
